description: Recent NFL player news articles from Google News RSS. Contains headlines, URLs, and publisher info. Frontend can scrape article content on-demand when user clicks 'Read More'.
refresh_schedule: Daily at 08:00 UTC (via Google News ingestion job)
use_case: Player news feed in FantasAI UI. Users click article links to scrape full content on frontend.

columns.name: player_id
columns.description: Master player ID from gold_player_dim (links to roster data)

columns.name: player_name
columns.description: Player name as searched in Google News

columns.name: position
columns.description: Player position (QB, RB, WR, TE, K, DEF)
Full URL to original article (clickable link for frontend scraper)

columns.name: publisher
columns.description: Source name (e.g., ESPN, The New York Times, Sports Illustrated)

columns.name: article_rank
columns.description: Rank (1-5) of article per player, ordered by recency (1 = most recent)

relationships.gold_player_dim: player_id → master_player_id (join for full player bio)
relationships.bronze_google_news: Source table (5,031 raw articles, deduplicated to top 5 per player)

frontend_usage.display: Show headline, publisher, published date, and clickable URL
frontend_usage.scraping: User clicks 'Read More' → Frontend scrapes article_url → Display full content in modal/sidebar
frontend_usage.caching: Frontend can cache scraped content per article_url to avoid re-scraping
